_comment: The fixed half of every English cover letter. Markdown allowed. The specific half lives in applications/<slug>/cover-letter.json. Order in the letter: letter.intro, fixed.about_me, letter.body, fixed.closing. Salutation: cover-letter.json's own "salutation" wins; otherwise salutation_named[posting.contact.salutation] ("_" when the title is unknown) with {salutation} {first_name} {last_name}; otherwise salutation_default.
about_me: I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Applied Information and Data Science at the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences. Alongside my studies I work as a working student in data analytics, automating reports and building dashboards for the controlling team.
closing: I would be delighted to discuss my application with you in person.
